acceptedClaims.declaredStatement: For the governed two-use half-skew BSSC, fix W and X^2 to four symbols and the four deterministic product-code orientations (U,V)=(X^2,0),(2X_1,X_2),(X_2,2X_1),(0,X^2), and vary only the 16 positive masses q(W,X^2). At the tensor product of the exact one-use RTD optimizer, whose 4x4 mass matrix has entries (11-sqrt(105))/120, 1/30, and (11+sqrt(105))/120 in the displayed symmetry pattern, the half-weight Marton functional L_{1/2} has constant gradient and a negative-definite Hessian on the full 15-dimensional simplex tangent space. A standard-library checker works exactly in Q(sqrt(105)), verifies all 15 gradient log-product identities, and gives an exact LDL^T decomposition with 15 strictly negative pivots and exact reconstruction. Hence this tensor point is a strict local maximum in the stated fixed-map quotient; its value is 2 L_RTD, and every distinct sufficiently close law in this quotient has selected-law Marton value below 2 L_RTD because min(E_Y,E_Z) <= L_{1/2}. This local theorem does not rule out distant points, directions activating other (W,U,V,X^2) atoms, stochastic or different maps, larger auxiliaries, a two-letter Marton gain in another architecture, Marton additivity, or a capacity converse.
acceptedClaims.validitySummary: The supplied audit establishes exact tangent-space stationarity and negative definiteness of the Hessian at the interior tensor point in the stated 16-cell fixed-map simplex, so the point is a strict local maximum. Exact tensor-product additivity and the required one-use RTD identification give value 2 L_RTD; min(E_Y,E_Z) <= L_{1/2} then yields the claimed strict inequality for every distinct sufficiently close selected law.
scopeQualifications: It does not address distant points, activation of other atoms, stochastic or different maps, larger auxiliaries, other two-letter architectures, Marton additivity, or a capacity converse.
It does not establish global optimality even within that quotient.
The result applies only to the open 16-cell quotient with the four specified deterministic product-code maps and variation solely of the positive masses q(W,X^2).
